snippet.title: The Patchmaker's Workshop - Opening Cutscene
snippet.description:
This is the opening cutscene for The Patchmaker's Workshop, my major Super Mario 64 ROM hack that is planned to release in January 2025. This cutscene features Sewnia, the living doll, finding a peculiar M-shaped patch in the depths of the workshop. However, something, or someone, seems to be pursuing her.

Discord: https://discord.gg/4SZPveH
